<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sp_widget"><sp_widget action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><category>custom</category><client_script><![CDATA[api.controller = function($scope, spUtil, $location, $timeout) {
  var c = this;

  // Workspace Navigation & Active Record
  c.activeWorkspaceTab = 'requests'; // 'requests' | 'approvals'
  c.selectedRecord = null;
  c.selectedRecordDetails = null;
  c.isApproverMode = false;

  c.data.combinedApprovals = [];
  c.activeCalc = null;

  // Search & Filtering State
  c.searchQuery = '';
  c.listFilter = 'pending';
  c.currentPage = 1;
  c.itemsPerPage = 10;

  // Approver Single Decision State
  c.decisionComments = '';
  c.approvedAmount = 0;

  // Multi-Select (Bulk) State
  c.selectAll = false;

  // Rejection Modal State
  c.showRejectModal = false;
  c.isBulkReject = false;
  c.targetRejectItem = null;
  c.rejectReason = '';

  // Direct Attachment Upload State
  c.isUploadingFile = false;

  // INR Currency Formatter
  c.formatINR = function(val) {
    if (val === undefined || val === null || val === '') return '0.00';
    var num = parseFloat(val);
    if (isNaN(num)) return '0.00';
    return num.toLocaleString('en-IN', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 });
  };

  c.$onInit = function() {
    c.fetchWorkspaceData();
  };

  c.fetchWorkspaceData = function() {
    c.data.isFetchingList = true;
    c.data.action = 'fetch_workspace_data';
    c.server.update().then(function() {
      c.data.action = '';
      c.data.isFetchingList = false;

      // Deep Linking Support
      var reqNum = $location.search().number;
      if (reqNum && !c.selectedRecord) {
        var matchApp = (c.data.approvals || []).find(function(a) { return a.number === reqNum; });
        if (matchApp) {
          c.activeWorkspaceTab = 'approvals';
          c.viewRecord(matchApp, true);
          return;
        }
        var matchReq = (c.data.batches || []).find(function(b) { return b.number === reqNum; });
        if (matchReq) {
          c.activeWorkspaceTab = 'requests';
          c.viewRecord(matchReq, false);
        }
      }
    });
  };

  c.setWorkspaceTab = function(tab) {
    c.activeWorkspaceTab = tab;
    c.listFilter = 'pending';
    c.currentPage = 1;
    c.clearBulkSelections();
  };

  c.setFilter = function(f) {
    c.listFilter = f;
    c.currentPage = 1;
    c.clearBulkSelections();
  };

  c.getFilteredItems = function() {
    var sourceArr = (c.activeWorkspaceTab === 'requests') ? (c.data.batches || []) : (c.data.approvals || []);

    if (c.listFilter === 'pending') {
      sourceArr = sourceArr.filter(function(item) { return item.internalState === 'pending' || item.internalState === 'work'; });
    } else if (c.listFilter === 'completed') {
      sourceArr = sourceArr.filter(function(item) { return item.internalState === 'approved' || item.internalState === 'rejected' || item.internalState === 'cancelled'; });
    }

    if (c.searchQuery) {
      var s = c.searchQuery.toLowerCase();
      sourceArr = sourceArr.filter(function(b) {
        return (b.number && b.number.toLowerCase().indexOf(s) > -1) ||
               (b.pan && b.pan.toLowerCase().indexOf(s) > -1) ||
               (b.customer_name && b.customer_name.toLowerCase().indexOf(s) > -1) ||
               (b.segment && b.segment.toLowerCase().indexOf(s) > -1) ||
               (b.created_by && b.created_by.toLowerCase().indexOf(s) > -1);
      });
    }
    return sourceArr;
  };

  c.getPaginatedItems = function() {
    var filtered = c.getFilteredItems();
    var startIndex = (c.currentPage - 1) * c.itemsPerPage;
    return filtered.slice(startIndex, startIndex + c.itemsPerPage);
  };

  c.totalPages = function() {
    return Math.ceil(c.getFilteredItems().length / c.itemsPerPage) || 1;
  };

  c.getMathMin = function(a, b) {
    return Math.min(a, b);
  };

  // =======================================================
  // PROPORTIONAL DISTRIBUTION ENGINE
  // =======================================================
  c.getProtectedFloor = function() {
    if (!c.selectedRecordDetails || !c.selectedRecordDetails.sites) return 0;
    var floor = 0;
    c.selectedRecordDetails.sites.forEach(function(s) {
      var ex = parseFloat(s.current_limit) || 0;
      var req = parseFloat(s.desired_limit) || 0;
      floor += Math.min(ex, req);
    });
    return floor;
  };

  c.recalculateDistribution = function() {
    if (!c.selectedRecordDetails || !c.selectedRecordDetails.sites) return;
    var sites = c.selectedRecordDetails.sites;
    var totalApproved = parseFloat(c.approvedAmount);
    if (isNaN(totalApproved)) totalApproved = 0;

    var totalExisting = 0;
    var totalNewAsk = 0;
    var totalRequested = 0;

    sites.forEach(function(s) {
      var ex = parseFloat(s.current_limit) || 0;
      var req = parseFloat(s.desired_limit) || 0;
      var floor = Math.min(ex, req);
      var inc = Math.max(0, req - ex);
      s._floor = floor;
      s._inc = inc;
      totalExisting += floor;
      totalNewAsk += inc;
      totalRequested += req;
    });

    if (c.selectedRecord && c.selectedRecord.state !== 'Requested') {
      return;
    }

    if (totalApproved >= totalRequested && totalRequested > 0) {
      sites.forEach(function(s) {
        s.approved_limit = parseFloat(s.desired_limit) || 0;
      });
      return;
    }

    var remainder = Math.max(0, totalApproved - totalExisting);

    sites.forEach(function(s) {
      if (totalNewAsk > 0) {
        var share = s._inc / totalNewAsk;
        s.approved_limit = s._floor + (remainder * share);
      } else if (totalRequested > 0) {
        var shareAll = (parseFloat(s.desired_limit) || 0) / totalRequested;
        s.approved_limit = totalApproved * shareAll;
      } else {
        s.approved_limit = 0;
      }
      s.approved_limit = Math.round(s.approved_limit * 100) / 100;
    });
  };

  // =======================================================
  // RECORD INSPECTION (VIEW DETAILS & APPROVAL REVIEW)
  // =======================================================
  c.viewRecord = function(item, isApprover) {
    c.selectedRecord = item;
    c.isApproverMode = isApprover;
    c.decisionComments = '';
    c.activeCalc = null;
    c.data.calcData = null;
    $location.search('number', item.number);

    c.data.action = 'get_record_details';
    c.data.batchSysId = item.pan_request_id || item.sys_id;
    c.data.approvalSysId = item.approval_sys_id || item.sys_id;

    c.server.update().then(function(response) {
      c.data.action = '';
      c.selectedRecordDetails = {
        sites: response.siteData || [],
        justification: response.batchJustification || '',
        description: response.batchDescription || '',
        attachments: response.attachments || []
      };
      c.data.combinedApprovals = response.combinedApprovals || [];

      if (response.panP1 !== undefined) c.selectedRecord.p1 = response.panP1;
      if (response.panP2 !== undefined) c.selectedRecord.p2 = response.panP2;
      if (response.panP3 !== undefined) c.selectedRecord.p3 = response.panP3;
      if (response.panTotalApproved !== undefined) c.selectedRecord.total_approved_limit = response.panTotalApproved;

      // Initialize Approved Amount for Approver View
      if (c.isApproverMode) {
        if (c.selectedRecord.state === 'Approved' && c.selectedRecord.total_approved_limit > 0) {
          c.approvedAmount = c.selectedRecord.total_approved_limit;
        } else {
          c.approvedAmount = item.total_desired;
        }
        c.recalculateDistribution();
      }
    });
  };

  c.goBack = function() {
    c.selectedRecord = null;
    c.selectedRecordDetails = null;
    c.data.combinedApprovals = [];
    c.activeCalc = null;
    $location.search('number', null);
  };

  // =======================================================
  // MULTI-ACTION (BULK APPROVE & BULK REJECT)
  // =======================================================
  c.toggleSelectAll = function() {
    var pageItems = c.getPaginatedItems();
    pageItems.forEach(function(item) { item.selected = c.selectAll; });
  };

  c.verifyHeaderCheckbox = function() {
    var pageItems = c.getPaginatedItems();
    c.selectAll = pageItems.length > 0 && pageItems.every(function(item) { return item.selected; });
  };

  c.getSelectedCount = function() {
    return (c.data.approvals || []).filter(function(a) { 
      return a.selected && (a.internalState === 'pending' || a.internalState === 'work'); 
    }).length;
  };

  c.clearBulkSelections = function() {
    (c.data.approvals || []).forEach(function(a) { a.selected = false; });
    c.selectAll = false;
  };

  c.processBulk = function(state, comments) {
    var selectedApps = (c.data.approvals || []).filter(function(a) { 
      return a.selected && (a.internalState === 'pending' || a.internalState === 'work'); 
    });

    if (selectedApps.length === 0) return;
    var selectedIds = selectedApps.map(function(a) { return a.sys_id; });

    c.data.isProcessingBulk = true;
    c.data.action = 'process_bulk_decision';
    c.data.bulkApprovalIds = selectedIds;
    c.data.bulkState = state;
    c.data.bulkComments = comments || (state === 'approved' ? 'Approved in bulk from workspace in full.' : '');

    c.server.update().then(function() {
      c.data.action = '';
      c.data.isProcessingBulk = false;
      c.cancelRejectModal();
      spUtil.addInfoMessage(selectedIds.length + " approval request(s) successfully " + (state === 'approved' ? 'Approved' : 'Rejected') + ".");
      c.clearBulkSelections();
      c.fetchWorkspaceData();
    }).catch(function() {
      c.data.isProcessingBulk = false;
      spUtil.addErrorMessage("Error processing bulk approval decisions.");
    });
  };

  // =======================================================
  // INLINE QUICK DECISIONS & REJECTION MODAL
  // =======================================================
  c.quickApprove = function(item) {
    if (!confirm("Are you sure you want to approve request " + item.number + " in full (₹ " + c.formatINR(item.total_desired) + ")?")) return;

    c.data.isProcessingBulk = true;
    c.data.action = 'process_approval_decision';
    c.data.approvalSysId = item.sys_id;
    c.data.batchSysId = item.pan_request_id;
    c.data.decisionState = 'approved';
    c.data.approvedAmount = item.total_desired;
    c.data.decisionComments = 'Approved directly from workspace inbox in full.';

    c.server.update().then(function() {
      c.data.action = '';
      c.data.isProcessingBulk = false;
      spUtil.addInfoMessage("Request " + item.number + " approved successfully.");
      c.fetchWorkspaceData();
    }).catch(function() {
      c.data.isProcessingBulk = false;
      spUtil.addErrorMessage("Failed to approve request.");
    });
  };

  c.openRejectModal = function(item, isBulk) {
    c.isBulkReject = isBulk;
    c.targetRejectItem = item;
    c.rejectReason = '';
    c.showRejectModal = true;
  };

  c.cancelRejectModal = function() {
    c.showRejectModal = false;
    c.targetRejectItem = null;
    c.rejectReason = '';
  };

  c.confirmRejectModal = function() {
    if (!c.rejectReason || !c.rejectReason.trim()) {
      spUtil.addErrorMessage("Comments are mandatory when rejecting requests.");
      return;
    }

    if (c.isBulkReject) {
      c.processBulk('rejected', c.rejectReason);
    } else {
      var item = c.targetRejectItem;
      c.data.isProcessingBulk = true;
      c.data.action = 'process_approval_decision';
      c.data.approvalSysId = item.sys_id;
      c.data.batchSysId = item.pan_request_id || item.sys_id;
      c.data.decisionState = 'rejected';
      c.data.approvedAmount = 0;
      c.data.decisionComments = c.rejectReason;

      c.server.update().then(function() {
        c.data.action = '';
        c.data.isProcessingBulk = false;
        c.cancelRejectModal();
        spUtil.addInfoMessage("Request " + item.number + " rejected successfully.");
        c.fetchWorkspaceData();
      }).catch(function() {
        c.data.isProcessingBulk = false;
        spUtil.addErrorMessage("Failed to reject request.");
      });
    }
  };

  // =======================================================
  // DETAIL DECISION & SUBMITTER CANCEL
  // =======================================================
  c.submitDecision = function(state) {
    if (state === 'rejected' && (!c.decisionComments || !c.decisionComments.trim())) {
      spUtil.addErrorMessage("Comments are mandatory when rejecting an approval.");
      return;
    }

    if (state === 'approved') {
      var floor = c.getProtectedFloor();
      if (c.approvedAmount < floor) {
        spUtil.addErrorMessage("Approved limit cannot be less than the protected existing limit floor of ₹ " + c.formatINR(floor));
        return;
      }
    }

    c.data.isProcessingDecision = true;
    c.data.action = 'process_approval_decision';
    c.data.approvalSysId = c.selectedRecord.sys_id;
    c.data.batchSysId = c.selectedRecord.pan_request_id || c.selectedRecord.sys_id;
    c.data.decisionState = state;
    c.data.approvedAmount = (state === 'approved') ? c.approvedAmount : 0;
    c.data.decisionComments = c.decisionComments;

    c.server.update().then(function(response) {
      c.data.action = '';
      c.data.isProcessingDecision = false;
      spUtil.addInfoMessage("Request has been successfully " + (state === 'approved' ? 'Approved' : 'Rejected') + ".");

      c.selectedRecord.state = (state === 'approved') ? 'Approved' : 'Rejected';
      c.selectedRecord.internalState = (state === 'approved') ? 'approved' : 'rejected';
      c.selectedRecord.total_approved_limit = (state === 'approved') ? c.approvedAmount : 0;
      c.selectedRecord.approval_comments = c.decisionComments;

      c.data.combinedApprovals = response.combinedApprovals || [];
      if (response.siteData) {
        c.selectedRecordDetails.sites = response.siteData;
      }

      c.fetchWorkspaceData();
    }).catch(function() {
      c.data.isProcessingDecision = false;
      spUtil.addErrorMessage("Failed to process approval decision.");
    });
  };

  c.cancelRequest = function(item) {
    if (confirm("Are you sure you want to cancel request " + item.number + "? Background approval workflows will be terminated.")) {
      c.data.action = 'cancel_batch';
      c.data.cancelBatchSysId = item.sys_id;
      c.server.update().then(function() {
        c.data.action = '';
        spUtil.addInfoMessage("Request " + item.number + " has been cancelled.");
        c.goBack();
        c.fetchWorkspaceData();
      });
    }
  };

  // =======================================================
  // CALCULATION ENGINE & AGING DRILLDOWN
  // =======================================================
  c.toggleSiteAging = function(site) {
    site.expanded = !site.expanded;
    if (site.expanded && !site.buckets) {
      site.isLoadingAging = true;
      c.server.get({
        action: 'get_site_aging',
        batchSysId: c.selectedRecord ? (c.selectedRecord.pan_request_id || c.selectedRecord.sys_id) : '',
        customerSysId: site.customer_sys_id,
        customerCode: site.code
      }).then(function(res) {
        site.isLoadingAging = false;
        site.buckets = (res.data.siteAging && res.data.siteAging.buckets) ? res.data.siteAging.buckets : [];
      }).catch(function() {
        site.isLoadingAging = false;
      });
    }
  };

  c.toggleCalc = function(calcType) {
    if (c.activeCalc === calcType) {
      c.activeCalc = null;
    } else {
      c.activeCalc = calcType;
      if (!c.data.calcData) {
        c.data.isLoadingCalc = true;
        var tempAction = c.data.action;
        c.data.action = 'get_calculation_details';
        c.data.calcBatchSysId = c.selectedRecord.pan_request_id || c.selectedRecord.sys_id;
        c.server.update().then(function() {
          c.data.action = tempAction;
          c.data.isLoadingCalc = false;
        });
      }
    }
  };

  // Direct Attachment Upload
  c.uploadDirectAttachment = function(element) {
    var file = element.files[0];
    if (!file) return;

    if (file.size > 5 * 1024 * 1024) {
      spUtil.addErrorMessage("File size exceeds 5MB limit.");
      element.value = '';
      return;
    }

    c.isUploadingFile = true;
    var reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = function(e) {
      var base64Data = e.target.result.split(',')[1];
      c.server.get({
        action: 'upload_document',
        batchSysId: c.selectedRecord.pan_request_id || c.selectedRecord.sys_id,
        fileName: file.name,
        fileType: file.type,
        fileData: base64Data
      }).then(function(res) {
        c.isUploadingFile = false;
        element.value = '';
        spUtil.addInfoMessage("Document uploaded successfully.");
        c.selectedRecordDetails.attachments = res.data.attachments || [];
      }).catch(function() {
        c.isUploadingFile = false;
        element.value = '';
        spUtil.addErrorMessage("Failed to upload document.");
      });
    };
    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
  };

  var CONFIG = {
    TABLES: {
      CUSTOMER: 'x_birl3_clm_clm_customer_master1',        // Customer Master[cite: 1]
      CUSTOMER_FORM: 'x_birl3_clm_customer_form',          // Customer Form with SOB & Potential fields[cite: 1]
      PAN_REQUEST: 'x_birl3_clm_nt_pan_request',           // Parent Batch[cite: 1]
      PAN_OUTSTANDING: 'x_birl3_clm_nt_pan_request_outstanding', // Dedicated Request Snapshot Table
      SITE_REQUEST: 'x_birl3_clm_nt_site_request',         // Child Site Lines[cite: 1]
      OUTSTANDING: 'x_birl3_clm_clm_aging_snapshot',       // 6-Month Aging Snapshot Fallback[cite: 1]
      APPROVALS: 'sysapproval_approver',                   // Standard Approvals[cite: 1]
      RISK_MATRIX: 'x_birl3_clm_risk_parameter_matrix',    // Parameter Options[cite: 1]
      REQ_PARAMS: 'x_birl3_clm_request_parameters'         // Persisted Parameters at PAN Level[cite: 1]
    }
  };

  var isAdmin = gs.hasRole('x_birl3_clm.admin') || gs.hasRole('admin');
  data.isAdmin = isAdmin;

  function getInternalState(stateStr) {
    var s = (stateStr || '').toLowerCase();
    if (s.indexOf('pending') > -1 || s.indexOf('requested') > -1) return 'pending';
    if (s.indexOf('approved') > -1 || s.indexOf('complete') > -1) return 'approved';
    if (s.indexOf('reject') > -1 || s.indexOf('cancel') > -1) return 'rejected';
    return 'work';
  }

  function formatPercentage(val) {
    if (val === null || val === undefined || val === '') return '0.0';
    var num = parseFloat(val) || 0;
    return (num > 1 || num === 0) ? num.toFixed(1) : (num * 100).toFixed(1);
  }

  function getApproverRole(appGr) {
    if (appGr.isValidField('approval_reason') && appGr.getValue('approval_reason')) {
      return appGr.getValue('approval_reason');
    }
    if (appGr.isValidField('approval_journal_column') && appGr.getValue('approval_journal_column')) {
      return appGr.getValue('approval_journal_column');
    }
    return 'Approver';
  }

  function formatBytes(bytes) {
    var b = parseInt(bytes, 10);
    if (isNaN(b) || b <= 0) return '0 B';
    var k = 1024;
    var sizes = ['B', 'KB', 'MB', 'GB'];
    var i = Math.floor(Math.log(b) / Math.log(k));
    return parseFloat((b / Math.pow(k, i)).toFixed(1)) + ' ' + sizes[i];
  }

  function getAttachmentsForRecord(recordSysId) {
    var attList = [];
    var attGr = new GlideRecord('sys_attachment');
    attGr.addQuery('table_name', CONFIG.TABLES.PAN_REQUEST);
    attGr.addQuery('table_sys_id', recordSysId);
    attGr.orderByDesc('sys_created_on');
    attGr.query();
    while (attGr.next()) {
      var fName = attGr.getValue('file_name') || '';
      var ext = fName.split('.').pop().toLowerCase();
      attList.push({
        sys_id: attGr.getUniqueValue(),
        name: fName,
        size: formatBytes(attGr.getValue('size_bytes')),
        ext: ext,
        url: '/sys_attachment.do?sys_id=' + attGr.getUniqueValue()
      });
    }
    return attList;
  }

  function distributeApprovedLimitToSites(panSysId, totalApprovedVal) {
    var siteList = [];
    var sGr = new GlideRecord(CONFIG.TABLES.SITE_REQUEST);
    sGr.addQuery('pan_request', panSysId);
    sGr.query();

    var totFloor = 0, totInc = 0, totReq = 0;

    while (sGr.next()) {
      var exLim = parseFloat(sGr.getValue('existing_credit_limit')) || 0;
      var reqLim = parseFloat(sGr.getValue('requested_limit') || sGr.getValue('site_desired_limit')) || 0;
      var sFloor = Math.min(exLim, reqLim);
      var sInc = Math.max(0, reqLim - exLim);

      totFloor += sFloor;
      totInc += sInc;
      totReq += reqLim;

      siteList.push({
        sys_id: sGr.getUniqueValue(),
        floor: sFloor,
        inc: sInc,
        req: reqLim
      });
    }

    var remainderPool = Math.max(0, totalApprovedVal - totFloor);

    for (var i = 0; i < siteList.length; i++) {
      var item = siteList[i];
      var sApproved = 0;

      if (totalApprovedVal >= totReq && totReq > 0) {
        sApproved = item.req;
      } else if (totInc > 0) {
        var share = item.inc / totInc;
        sApproved = item.floor + (remainderPool * share);
      } else if (totReq > 0) {
        sApproved = totalApprovedVal * (item.req / totReq);
      } else {
        sApproved = 0;
      }

      sApproved = Math.round(sApproved * 100) / 100;

      var siteUpd = new GlideRecord(CONFIG.TABLES.SITE_REQUEST);
      if (siteUpd.get(item.sys_id)) {
        siteUpd.setValue('approved_limit', sApproved);
        siteUpd.update();
      }
    }
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // 1. DIRECT ATTACHMENT UPLOAD
  // =========================================================================
  if (input && input.action == 'upload_document') {
    var targetPanRec = new GlideRecord(CONFIG.TABLES.PAN_REQUEST);
    if (targetPanRec.get(input.batchSysId)) {
      if (input.fileData && input.fileName && input.fileType) {
        new GlideSysAttachment().writeBase64(targetPanRec, input.fileName, input.fileType, input.fileData);
      }
    }
    data.attachments = getAttachmentsForRecord(input.batchSysId);
    return;
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // 2. CANCEL BATCH REQUEST (SUBMITTER ACTION)
  // =========================================================================
  if (input && input.action == 'cancel_batch') {
    var cancelPan = new GlideRecord(CONFIG.TABLES.PAN_REQUEST);
    if (cancelPan.get(input.cancelBatchSysId)) {
      cancelPan.setValue('approval', 'rejected');
      cancelPan.comments = "System Action: Limit request cancelled by " + gs.getUserDisplayName() + ".";
      cancelPan.update();

      var panApps = new GlideRecord(CONFIG.TABLES.APPROVALS);
      panApps.addQuery('sysapproval', input.cancelBatchSysId);
      panApps.addQuery('state', 'requested');
      panApps.query();
      while (panApps.next()) {
        panApps.setValue('state', 'cancelled');
        panApps.update();
      }

      var siteLines = new GlideRecord(CONFIG.TABLES.SITE_REQUEST);
      siteLines.addQuery('pan_request', input.cancelBatchSysId);
      siteLines.query();
      while (siteLines.next()) {
        siteLines.setValue('approval', 'rejected');
        siteLines.update();
      }
    }
    return;
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // 3. PROCESS APPROVAL DECISION (SINGLE)
  // =========================================================================
  if (input && input.action == 'process_approval_decision') {
    var appGr = new GlideRecord(CONFIG.TABLES.APPROVALS);
    if (appGr.get(input.approvalSysId)) {
      appGr.setValue('state', input.decisionState);
      if (input.decisionComments) {
        appGr.comments = input.decisionComments;
      }
      appGr.update();
    }

    var panParent = new GlideRecord(CONFIG.TABLES.PAN_REQUEST);
    if (panParent.get(input.batchSysId)) {
      var decisionLabel = input.decisionState === 'approved' ? 'Approved' : 'Rejected';
      var decisionNote = 'Approver Decision: ' + decisionLabel + ' by ' + gs.getUserDisplayName();

      if (input.decisionState === 'approved') {
        var reqTotal = parseFloat(panParent.getValue('total_requested_limit') || panParent.getValue('total_desired_limit')) || 0;
        var approvedAmount = parseFloat(input.approvedAmount);
        if (isNaN(approvedAmount) || approvedAmount <= 0) {
          approvedAmount = reqTotal;
        }
        panParent.setValue('total_approved_limit', approvedAmount);
        decisionNote += '\nTotal Approved Limit: ₹ ' + approvedAmount.toFixed(2);

        distributeApprovedLimitToSites(input.batchSysId, approvedAmount);
      } else if (input.decisionState === 'rejected') {
        panParent.setValue('total_approved_limit', 0);
        var sRej = new GlideRecord(CONFIG.TABLES.SITE_REQUEST);
        sRej.addQuery('pan_request', input.batchSysId);
        sRej.query();
        while (sRej.next()) {
          sRej.setValue('approved_limit', 0);
          sRej.update();
        }
      }

      if (input.decisionComments) {
        decisionNote += '\nComments: ' + input.decisionComments;
      }
      panParent.comments = decisionNote;
      panParent.update();
    }

    data.combinedApprovals = [];
    var panAppsGr = new GlideRecord(CONFIG.TABLES.APPROVALS);
    panAppsGr.addQuery('sysapproval', input.batchSysId);
    panAppsGr.orderBy('sys_created_on');
    panAppsGr.query();
    while (panAppsGr.next()) {
      data.combinedApprovals.push({
        approver_name: panAppsGr.getDisplayValue('approver') || 'System Approver',
        role: getApproverRole(panAppsGr),
        state: panAppsGr.getDisplayValue('state') || 'Requested',
        updated: panAppsGr.getValue('sys_updated_on') || ''
      });
    }

    data.siteData = [];
    var siteGrRefresh = new GlideRecord(CONFIG.TABLES.SITE_REQUEST);
    siteGrRefresh.addQuery('pan_request', input.batchSysId);
    siteGrRefresh.query();
    while (siteGrRefresh.next()) {
      data.siteData.push({
        sys_id: siteGrRefresh.getUniqueValue(),
        code: siteGrRefresh.getValue('customer_code') || '',
        current_limit: parseFloat(siteGrRefresh.getValue('existing_credit_limit')) || 0,
        desired_limit: parseFloat(siteGrRefresh.getValue('requested_limit') || siteGrRefresh.getValue('site_desired_limit')) || 0,
        approved_limit: parseFloat(siteGrRefresh.getValue('approved_limit')) || 0
      });
    }
    return;
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // 4. PROCESS MULTI-ACTION (BULK APPROVE / BULK REJECT)
  // =========================================================================
  if (input && input.action == 'process_bulk_decision') {
    var bulkIds = input.bulkApprovalIds || [];
    var bulkState = input.bulkState;
    var bulkComments = input.bulkComments || '';

    var bAppGr = new GlideRecord(CONFIG.TABLES.APPROVALS);
    bAppGr.addQuery('sys_id', 'IN', bulkIds.join(','));
    if (!isAdmin) {
      bAppGr.addQuery('approver', gs.getUserID());
    }
    bAppGr.query();

    while (bAppGr.next()) {
      bAppGr.setValue('state', bulkState);
      if (bulkComments) {
        bAppGr.comments = bulkComments;
      }
      bAppGr.update();

      var pId = bAppGr.getValue('sysapproval');
      if (pId) {
        var pGr = new GlideRecord(CONFIG.TABLES.PAN_REQUEST);
        if (pGr.get(pId)) {
          var decText = (bulkState === 'approved' ? 'Approved' : 'Rejected');
          var pNote = 'Bulk Approver Decision: ' + decText + ' by ' + gs.getUserDisplayName();

          if (bulkState === 'approved') {
            var reqTotal = parseFloat(pGr.getValue('total_requested_limit') || pGr.getValue('total_desired_limit')) || 0;
            pGr.setValue('total_approved_limit', reqTotal);
            pNote += '\nTotal Approved Limit: ₹ ' + reqTotal.toFixed(2);
            distributeApprovedLimitToSites(pId, reqTotal);
          } else if (bulkState === 'rejected') {
            pGr.setValue('total_approved_limit', 0);
            var sRejBulk = new GlideRecord(CONFIG.TABLES.SITE_REQUEST);
            sRejBulk.addQuery('pan_request', pId);
            sRejBulk.query();
            while (sRejBulk.next()) {
              sRejBulk.setValue('approved_limit', 0);
              sRejBulk.update();
            }
          }

          if (bulkComments) pNote += '\nComments: ' + bulkComments;
          pGr.comments = pNote;
          pGr.update();
        }
      }
    }
    return;
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // 5. FETCH WORKSPACE DATA (REQUESTS & APPROVALS)
  // =========================================================================
  if (!input || input.action == 'fetch_workspace_data' || !input.action) {
    data.batches = [];
    data.approvals = [];
    var pendingCounter = 0;

    // 1. Fetch Requests Dashboard (PAN Batches)
    var grPan = new GlideRecord(CONFIG.TABLES.PAN_REQUEST);
    if (!isAdmin) {
      grPan.addQuery('sys_created_by', gs.getUserName());
    }
    grPan.orderByDesc('sys_created_on');
    grPan.query();

    while (grPan.next()) {
      var panSysId = grPan.getUniqueValue();
      var panStr = grPan.getValue('pan') || '';
      var stateDisplay = grPan.getDisplayValue('approval') || grPan.getDisplayValue('state') || 'Pending';
      var displayNum = grPan.getValue('number') || ('REQ-' + panStr);

      var siteCounter = new GlideAggregate(CONFIG.TABLES.SITE_REQUEST);
      siteCounter.addQuery('pan_request', panSysId);
      siteCounter.addAggregate('COUNT');
      siteCounter.query();
      var siteCount = 0;
      if (siteCounter.next()) {
        siteCount = siteCounter.getAggregate('COUNT') || 0;
      }

      var custName = 'Corporate Group';
      var cGr = new GlideRecord(CONFIG.TABLES.CUSTOMER);
      cGr.addQuery('pan', panStr);
      cGr.setLimit(1);
      cGr.query();
      if (cGr.next()) {
        custName = cGr.getValue('group_customer_name') || cGr.getValue('customer_name') || cGr.getValue('name') || custName;
      }

      data.batches.push({
        sys_id: panSysId,
        number: displayNum,
        pan: panStr,
        customer_name: custName,
        site_count: siteCount,
        company_type: grPan.getValue('company_type') || '',
        segment: grPan.getDisplayValue('segment') || '',
        existing_limit: parseFloat(grPan.getValue('total_existing_limit')) || 0,
        total_desired: parseFloat(grPan.getValue('total_requested_limit') || grPan.getValue('total_desired_limit')) || 0,
        total_approved_limit: parseFloat(grPan.getValue('total_approved_limit')) || 0,
        safe_limit: parseFloat(grPan.getValue('total_safe_allowable_limit') || grPan.getValue('safe_allowable_limit')) || 0,
        p1: parseFloat(grPan.getValue('total_macl') || grPan.getValue('macl_p1')) || 0,
        p2: formatPercentage(grPan.getValue('total_composite_index') || grPan.getValue('composite_index_p2')),
        p3: formatPercentage(grPan.getValue('total_credit_index') || grPan.getValue('credit_index_p3')),
        deviation: (grPan.getValue('is_deviation') == 1 || grPan.getValue('is_deviation') == 'true'),

        created_on: (grPan.getValue('sys_created_on') || '').split(' ')[0]

    data.requestsCount = data.batches.length;

    // 2. Fetch Approvals Inbox
    var grApp = new GlideRecord(CONFIG.TABLES.APPROVALS);
    grApp.addQuery('source_table', CONFIG.TABLES.PAN_REQUEST);
    if (!isAdmin) {
      grApp.addQuery('approver', gs.getUserID());
    }
    grApp.orderByDesc('sys_created_on');
    grApp.query();

    while (grApp.next()) {
      var panTargetId = grApp.getValue('sysapproval');
      var panGrMatch = new GlideRecord(CONFIG.TABLES.PAN_REQUEST);
      if (!panGrMatch.get(panTargetId)) continue;

      var appDisplayNum = panGrMatch.getValue('number') || ('REQ-' + panCodeStr);

      sCounter.addQuery('pan_request', panTargetId);
      sCounter.addAggregate('COUNT');
      sCounter.query();
      var appSiteCount = 0;
      if (sCounter.next()) {
        appSiteCount = sCounter.getAggregate('COUNT') || 0;
      }

      var appCustName = 'Corporate Group';
      var cGrApp = new GlideRecord(CONFIG.TABLES.CUSTOMER);
      cGrApp.addQuery('pan', panCodeStr);
      cGrApp.setLimit(1);
      cGrApp.query();
      if (cGrApp.next()) {
        appCustName = cGrApp.getValue('group_customer_name') || cGrApp.getValue('customer_name') || cGrApp.getValue('name') || appCustName;
      }

      data.approvals.push({
        sys_id: grApp.getUniqueValue(),
        approval_sys_id: grApp.getUniqueValue(),
        pan_request_id: panTargetId,
        number: appDisplayNum,
        pan: panCodeStr,
        customer_name: appCustName,
        site_count: appSiteCount,
        company_type: panGrMatch.getValue('company_type') || '',
        segment: panGrMatch.getDisplayValue('segment') || '',
        existing_limit: parseFloat(panGrMatch.getValue('total_existing_limit')) || 0,
        total_desired: parseFloat(panGrMatch.getValue('total_requested_limit') || panGrMatch.getValue('total_desired_limit')) || 0,
        total_approved_limit: parseFloat(panGrMatch.getValue('total_approved_limit')) || 0,
        safe_limit: parseFloat(panGrMatch.getValue('total_safe_allowable_limit') || panGrMatch.getValue('safe_allowable_limit')) || 0,
        p1: parseFloat(panGrMatch.getValue('total_macl') || panGrMatch.getValue('macl_p1')) || 0,
        p2: formatPercentage(panGrMatch.getValue('total_composite_index') || panGrMatch.getValue('composite_index_p2')),
        p3: formatPercentage(panGrMatch.getValue('total_credit_index') || panGrMatch.getValue('credit_index_p3')),
        deviation: (panGrMatch.getValue('is_deviation') == 1 || panGrMatch.getValue('is_deviation') == 'true'),
        state: appStateStr,
        internalState: getInternalState(appStateStr),
        approval_comments: grApp.getValue('comments') || '',
        created_by: panGrMatch.getDisplayValue('sys_created_by') || 'System',
        created_on: (panGrMatch.getValue('sys_created_on') || '').split(' ')[0],
        selected: false
      });
    }
    data.pendingApprovalsCount = pendingCounter;
    return;
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // 6. FETCH RECORD DETAILS & ROW-COLUMN SITE MATRIX
  // =========================================================================
  if (input && input.action == 'get_record_details') {
    data.siteData = [];
    data.combinedApprovals = [];

    var targetPan = new GlideRecord(CONFIG.TABLES.PAN_REQUEST);
    var panJustification = '';
    var panDescription   = '';
    var panP1Val = 0, panP2Val = 0, panP3Val = 0;
    var panApprovedLimit = 0;

    if (targetPan.get(input.batchSysId)) {
      panJustification = targetPan.getValue('justification') || '';
      panDescription   = targetPan.getValue('description') || '';
      panP1Val = parseFloat(targetPan.getValue('total_macl') || targetPan.getValue('macl_p1')) || 0;
      panP2Val = parseFloat(targetPan.getValue('total_composite_index') || targetPan.getValue('composite_index_p2')) || 0;
      panP3Val = parseFloat(targetPan.getValue('total_credit_index') || targetPan.getValue('credit_index_p3')) || 0;
      panApprovedLimit = parseFloat(targetPan.getValue('total_approved_limit')) || 0;
    }
    data.batchJustification = panJustification;
    data.batchDescription   = panDescription;
    data.panTotalApproved   = panApprovedLimit;
    data.attachments        = getAttachmentsForRecord(input.batchSysId);

    var siteGr = new GlideRecord(CONFIG.TABLES.SITE_REQUEST);
    siteGr.addQuery('pan_request', input.batchSysId);
    siteGr.query();

    var aggP1 = 0, aggP2 = 0, aggP3 = 0, siteCount = 0;

    while (siteGr.next()) {
      siteCount++;
      var siteSysId = siteGr.getUniqueValue();

      var sCode = siteGr.getValue('customer_code') || '';
      if (!sCode && siteGr.isValidField('customer_site_code') && siteGr.customer_site_code) {
        var refCode = siteGr.customer_site_code.customer_code_sap ? siteGr.customer_site_code.customer_code_sap.toString() : '';
        if (!refCode && siteGr.customer_site_code.customer_code) {
          refCode = siteGr.customer_site_code.customer_code.toString();
        }
        sCode = refCode || siteGr.getValue('customer_site_code') || '';
      }

      var cSysId = '', cName = '', zCode = '', zName = '', rCode = '', rName = '', dCode = '', dName = '';
      var curLimit = 0, actBg = 0, bgExpDate = '';

      var cRef = new GlideRecord(CONFIG.TABLES.CUSTOMER);
      if (cRef.get('customer_code_sap', sCode) || cRef.get('customer_code', sCode) || cRef.get(sCode)) {
        cSysId    = cRef.getUniqueValue();
        sCode     = cRef.getValue('customer_code_sap') || cRef.getValue('customer_code') || sCode;
        cName     = cRef.getValue('customer_name') || cRef.getValue('name') || '';
        zCode     = cRef.getValue('zone') || '';
        zName     = cRef.getValue('zone_name') || cRef.getDisplayValue('zone') || zCode;
        rCode     = cRef.getValue('region') || '';
        rName     = cRef.getValue('region_name') || cRef.getDisplayValue('region') || rCode;
        dCode     = cRef.getValue('depot') || '';
        dName     = cRef.getValue('depot_name') || cRef.getDisplayValue('depot') || dCode;
        curLimit  = parseFloat(cRef.getValue('credit_limit')) || 0;
        actBg     = parseFloat(cRef.getValue('active_bg') || cRef.getValue('bank_guarantee')) || 0;
        bgExpDate = cRef.getValue('bg_expiry_date') || '';
      }

      var siteP1 = parseFloat(siteGr.getValue('macl')) || 0;
      var siteP2 = parseFloat(siteGr.getValue('composite_index')) || 0;
      var siteP3 = parseFloat(siteGr.getValue('credit_index')) || 0;

      aggP1 += siteP1;
      aggP2 += siteP2;
      aggP3 += siteP3;

      var existingLimitVal = parseFloat(siteGr.getValue('existing_credit_limit')) || curLimit;
      var desiredLimitVal = parseFloat(siteGr.getValue('requested_limit') || siteGr.getValue('site_desired_limit')) || 0;
      var approvedLimitVal = parseFloat(siteGr.getValue('approved_limit')) || 0;

      data.siteData.push({
        sys_id: siteSysId,
        customer_sys_id: cSysId,
        code: sCode,
        customer_name: cName,
        zone_code: zCode,
        zone_name: zName,
        region_code: rCode,
        region_name: rName,
        depot_code: dCode,
        depot_name: dName,
        current_limit: existingLimitVal,
        outstanding: parseFloat(siteGr.getValue('existing_outstanding')) || 0,
        active_bg: parseFloat(siteGr.getValue('existing_bg')) || actBg,
        bg_expiry: bgExpDate,
        order_rate: parseFloat(siteGr.getValue('order_rate') || siteGr.getValue('rate_mt')) || 0,
        nod: siteGr.getValue('nod') || '45',
        safe_limit: parseFloat(siteGr.getValue('safe_allowable_limit')) || 0,
        desired_limit: desiredLimitVal,
        approved_limit: approvedLimitVal,
        is_deviated: (siteGr.getValue('is_deviation') == 1 || siteGr.getValue('is_deviation') == 'true'),
        justification: siteGr.getValue('justification') || '',
        expanded: false,
        buckets: null
      });
    }

    data.panP1 = panP1Val > 0 ? panP1Val : aggP1;
    data.panP2 = panP2Val > 0 ? formatPercentage(panP2Val) : (siteCount > 0 ? formatPercentage(aggP2 / siteCount) : '0.0');
    data.panP3 = panP3Val > 0 ? formatPercentage(panP3Val) : (siteCount > 0 ? formatPercentage(aggP3 / siteCount) : '0.0');

    var panAppsGr = new GlideRecord(CONFIG.TABLES.APPROVALS);
    panAppsGr.addQuery('sysapproval', input.batchSysId);
    panAppsGr.orderBy('sys_created_on');
    panAppsGr.query();
    while (panAppsGr.next()) {
      data.combinedApprovals.push({
        approver_name: panAppsGr.getDisplayValue('approver') || 'System Approver',
        role: getApproverRole(panAppsGr),
        state: panAppsGr.getDisplayValue('state') || 'Requested',
        updated: panAppsGr.getValue('sys_updated_on') || ''
      });
    }
    return;
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // 7. GET SITE-SPECIFIC 6-MONTH AGING DRILLDOWN
  // =========================================================================
  if (input && input.action == 'get_site_aging') {
    var custSysId = input.customerSysId;
    var batchSysId = input.batchSysId || '';

    if (!custSysId && input.customerCode) {
      var cFind = new GlideRecord(CONFIG.TABLES.CUSTOMER);
      if (cFind.get('customer_code_sap', input.customerCode) || cFind.get('customer_code', input.customerCode)) {
        custSysId = cFind.getUniqueValue();
      }
    }

    var buckets = [];

    if (batchSysId && custSysId) {
      var snapPanGr = new GlideRecord(CONFIG.TABLES.PAN_OUTSTANDING);
      snapPanGr.addQuery('pan_request', batchSysId);
      snapPanGr.addQuery('customer_site_code', custSysId);
      snapPanGr.orderBy('snapshot_month');
      snapPanGr.setLimit(6);
      snapPanGr.query();

      while (snapPanGr.next()) {
        var b03  = parseFloat(snapPanGr.getValue('bucket_0_21_days') || snapPanGr.getValue('bucket_0_30_days')) || 0;
        var b47  = parseFloat(snapPanGr.getValue('bucket_22_30_days') || snapPanGr.getValue('bucket_31_45_days')) || 0;
        var b821 = parseFloat(snapPanGr.getValue('bucket_31_45_days') || snapPanGr.getValue('bucket_46_60_days')) || 0;
        var b22  = parseFloat(snapPanGr.getValue('bucket_46_60_days') || snapPanGr.getValue('bucket_61_75_days')) || 0;
        var b31  = parseFloat(snapPanGr.getValue('bucket_61_75_days') || snapPanGr.getValue('bucket_76_90_days')) || 0;
        var bgt  = parseFloat(snapPanGr.getValue('bucket_gt120_days')) ||
                   (parseFloat(snapPanGr.getValue('bucket_91_120_days')) || 0) +
                   (parseFloat(snapPanGr.getValue('bucket_121_180_days')) || 0);

        var rowTotalOs = parseFloat(snapPanGr.getValue('total_outstanding')) || (b03 + b47 + b821 + b22 + b31 + bgt);

        buckets.push({
          month: (snapPanGr.getValue('snapshot_month') || '').split(' ')[0],
          b0_3: b03,
          b4_7: b47,
          b8_21: b821,
          b22_30: b22,
          b31_45: b31,
          b_gt90: bgt,
          total_os: rowTotalOs
        });
      }
    }

    if (buckets.length === 0 && custSysId) {
      var outGr = new GlideRecord(CONFIG.TABLES.OUTSTANDING);
      outGr.addQuery('customer', custSysId);
      outGr.orderBy('snapshot_month');
      outGr.setLimit(6);
      outGr.query();

      while (outGr.next()) {
        var fb03  = parseFloat(outGr.getValue('bucket_0_30_days'))  || 0;
        var fb47  = parseFloat(outGr.getValue('bucket_31_45_days')) || 0;
        var fb821 = parseFloat(outGr.getValue('bucket_46_60_days')) || 0;
        var fb22  = parseFloat(outGr.getValue('bucket_61_75_days')) || 0;
        var fb31  = parseFloat(outGr.getValue('bucket_76_90_days')) || 0;
        var fbgt  = (parseFloat(outGr.getValue('bucket_91_120_days'))  || 0) + 
                    (parseFloat(outGr.getValue('bucket_121_180_days')) || 0) + 
                    (parseFloat(outGr.getValue('bucket_gt120_days'))   || 0);

        var fbRowTotalOs = parseFloat(outGr.getValue('total_outstanding')) || (fb03 + fb47 + fb821 + fb22 + fb31 + fbgt);

        buckets.push({
          month: (outGr.getValue('snapshot_month') || '').split(' ')[0],
          b0_3: fb03,
          b4_7: fb47,
          b8_21: fb821,
          b22_30: fb22,
          b31_45: fb31,
          b_gt90: fbgt,
          total_os: fbRowTotalOs
        });
      }
    }

    data.siteAging = { buckets: buckets };
    return;
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // 8. CALCULATION DRILLDOWN (P1, P2, P3)
  // =========================================================================
  if (input && input.action == 'get_calculation_details') {
    data.calcData = { p1: {}, p2: [], p2Total: 0, p3: { buckets: {} }, maclSites: [] };
    var bSysId = input.calcBatchSysId;
    var batchGrObj = new GlideRecord(CONFIG.TABLES.PAN_REQUEST);

    if (batchGrObj.get(bSysId)) {
      var panVal = batchGrObj.getValue('pan');
      data.calcData.p1.isListed = (batchGrObj.getValue('company_type') === 'Listed');
      data.calcData.p1.netWorth = parseFloat(batchGrObj.getValue('net_worth') || batchGrObj.getValue('net_worths')) || 0;
      data.calcData.p1.loans    = parseFloat(batchGrObj.getValue('loans_advances')) || 0;

      var reqSiteMap = {};
      var cSite = new GlideRecord(CONFIG.TABLES.SITE_REQUEST);
      cSite.addQuery('pan_request', bSysId);
      cSite.query();
      while (cSite.next()) {
        var rawCustCode = cSite.getValue('customer_code') || '';
        if (!rawCustCode && cSite.isValidField('customer_site_code') && cSite.customer_site_code) {
          rawCustCode = cSite.customer_site_code.customer_code_sap ? cSite.customer_site_code.customer_code_sap.toString() : (cSite.customer_site_code.customer_code ? cSite.customer_site_code.customer_code.toString() : '');
        }
        if (rawCustCode) {
          reqSiteMap[rawCustCode] = {
            total_potential: parseFloat(cSite.getValue('total_potential')) || 0,
            current_sob_mt:  parseFloat(cSite.getValue('ut_sob')) || 0,
            expected_sob_mt: parseFloat(cSite.getValue('expected_sob')) || 0,
            macl:            parseFloat(cSite.getValue('macl')) || 0,
            requested_limit: parseFloat(cSite.getValue('requested_limit')) || 0
          };
        }
      }

      var custFormMap = {};
      var fGr = new GlideRecord(CONFIG.TABLES.CUSTOMER_FORM);
      fGr.query();
      while (fGr.next()) {
        var custId = fGr.getValue('customer') || '';
        if (custId) {
          custFormMap[custId] = {
            site_total_potential: parseFloat(fGr.getValue('site_total_potential')) || 0,
            site_expected_sob:     parseFloat(fGr.getValue('site_expected_sob')) || 0,
            site_ut_sob:           parseFloat(fGr.getValue('site_ut_sob')) || 0
          };
        }
      }

      var masterSites = new GlideRecord(CONFIG.TABLES.CUSTOMER);
      masterSites.addQuery('pan', panVal);
      masterSites.orderBy('customer_code');
      masterSites.query();

      while (masterSites.next()) {
        var custCode = masterSites.getValue('customer_code_sap') || masterSites.getValue('customer_code') || masterSites.getUniqueValue();
        var masterSysId = masterSites.getUniqueValue();

        var siteReqInfo  = reqSiteMap[custCode] || null;
        var formDataInfo = custFormMap[masterSysId] || custFormMap[custCode] || null;

        var siteTotPot = 0, siteCurSob = 0, siteExpSob = 0, siteMacl = 0, siteReqLim = 0;

        if (siteReqInfo) {
          siteTotPot = siteReqInfo.total_potential;
          siteCurSob = siteReqInfo.current_sob_mt;
          siteExpSob = siteReqInfo.expected_sob_mt;
          siteMacl   = siteReqInfo.macl;
          siteReqLim = siteReqInfo.requested_limit;
        } else if (formDataInfo) {
          siteTotPot = formDataInfo.site_total_potential || 0;
          siteCurSob = formDataInfo.site_ut_sob || 0;
          siteExpSob = formDataInfo.site_expected_sob || 0;
          siteMacl   = parseFloat(masterSites.getValue('macl')) || 0;
          siteReqLim = 0;
        } else {
          siteTotPot = parseFloat(masterSites.getValue('total_potential')) || 0;
          siteCurSob = 0;
          siteExpSob = 0;
          siteMacl   = parseFloat(masterSites.getValue('macl')) || 0;
          siteReqLim = 0;
        }

        data.calcData.maclSites.push({
          code: custCode,
          name: masterSites.getValue('customer_name') || masterSites.getValue('name') || '',
          zone: masterSites.getDisplayValue('zone') || '',
          region: masterSites.getDisplayValue('region') || '',
          depot: masterSites.getDisplayValue('depot') || '',
          total_potential: siteTotPot,
          current_sob_mt: siteCurSob,
          expected_sob_mt: siteExpSob,
          macl: siteMacl,
          requested_limit: siteReqLim
        });
      }

      var p2Tot = 0;
      var paramGr = new GlideRecord(CONFIG.TABLES.REQ_PARAMS);
      paramGr.addQuery('request', bSysId);
      paramGr.query();
      while (paramGr.next()) {
        var matrixGr = new GlideRecord(CONFIG.TABLES.RISK_MATRIX);
        var riskParamId = paramGr.getValue('risk_parameter');
        if (riskParamId && matrixGr.get(riskParamId)) {
          var score  = parseFloat(matrixGr.getValue('score_value')) || 0;
          var weight = parseFloat(matrixGr.getValue('weight_percentage')) || 0;
          var calc   = score * weight;
          p2Tot += calc;

          data.calcData.p2.push({
            name: matrixGr.getValue('parameter_name') || '',
            label: matrixGr.getValue('option_label') || '',
            score: score,
            weight: weight,
            calculated: (calc / 10).toFixed(1)
          });
        }
      }
      data.calcData.p2Total = (p2Tot / 10).toFixed(1);

      var safeL = 0, warningM = 0, criticalN = 0, toxicO = 0;
      var foundSnapshotData = false;

      var panSnapCheck = new GlideRecord(CONFIG.TABLES.PAN_OUTSTANDING);
      panSnapCheck.addQuery('pan_request', bSysId);
      panSnapCheck.query();

      while (panSnapCheck.next()) {
        foundSnapshotData = true;
        safeL     += (parseFloat(panSnapCheck.getValue('bucket_0_21_days')) || parseFloat(panSnapCheck.getValue('bucket_0_30_days')) || 0) +
                     (parseFloat(panSnapCheck.getValue('bucket_22_30_days')) || 0) +
                     (parseFloat(panSnapCheck.getValue('bucket_31_45_days')) || 0) +
                     (parseFloat(panSnapCheck.getValue('bucket_46_60_days')) || 0);
        warningM  += parseFloat(panSnapCheck.getValue('bucket_61_75_days')) || 0;
        criticalN += parseFloat(panSnapCheck.getValue('bucket_76_90_days')) || 0;
        toxicO    += (parseFloat(panSnapCheck.getValue('bucket_91_120_days')) || 0) + (parseFloat(panSnapCheck.getValue('bucket_gt120_days')) || 0);
      }

      if (!foundSnapshotData) {
        var panCustSysIds = [];
        var cGrAll = new GlideRecord(CONFIG.TABLES.CUSTOMER);
        cGrAll.addQuery('pan', panVal);
        cGrAll.query();
        while (cGrAll.next()) {
          panCustSysIds.push(cGrAll.getUniqueValue());
        }

        if (panCustSysIds.length > 0) {
          var outGrData = new GlideRecord(CONFIG.TABLES.OUTSTANDING);
          outGrData.addQuery('customer', 'IN', panCustSysIds.join(','));
          outGrData.orderByDesc('sys_created_on');
          outGrData.query();
          while (outGrData.next()) {
            safeL     += (parseFloat(outGrData.getValue('bucket_0_30_days'))  || 0) +
                         (parseFloat(outGrData.getValue('bucket_31_45_days')) || 0) +
                         (parseFloat(outGrData.getValue('bucket_46_60_days')) || 0);

    <!-- Calculation Drilldown Panel -->

                    <th class="text-right text-primary">MACL (P1)</th>
                    <th class="text-right text-danger">Requested Limit</th>

                </thead>
                <tbody>

                    <td>{{::site.depot || '-'}}</td>

                    <td class="text-right font-weight-bold">{{::c.formatINR(site.expected_sob_mt)}}</td>

                    <td class="text-center vertical-middle text-muted">{{::param.weight}}%</td>

                </tbody>
              </table>

              <div class="col-xs-12 col-sm-6 text-center">

                  <h5 class="m-t-none text-muted font-weight-bold">Internal Aging Rating</h5>

              <table class="table table-bordered text-center m-b-none" style="font-size: 13px;">
                <thead class="bg-light">
                  <tr>
                    <th>Safe Buckets (0-60 Days)</th>
                    <th>Warning (61-75 Days)</th>
                    <th>Critical (76-90 Days)</th>

                    <th class="bg-gray font-weight-bold">Total Historical Outstanding</th>

                  <tr>

            <i class="fa fa-table text-danger m-r-xs"></i> Site Commercial Breakdown

        </div>
        <div class="col-sm-6 text-right">
          <span class="text-muted small"><i class="fa fa-info-circle"></i> Click chevron to view 6-month outstanding aging</span>

            <tr>

            <tr ng-repeat-start="site in c.selectedRecordDetails.sites">

                </div>
              </td>

              <td class="vertical-middle site-meta-text">
                <div><strong class="text-muted">Zone:</strong> {{site.zone_code}} {{site.zone_name ? '-' : ''}} {{site.zone_name}}</div>
                <div><strong class="text-muted">Region:</strong> {{site.region_code}} {{site.region_name ? '-' : ''}} {{site.region_name}}</div>
                <div><strong class="text-muted">Depot:</strong> {{site.depot_code}} {{site.depot_name ? '-' : ''}} {{site.depot_name}}</div>

                <small class="text-muted display-block" ng-if="site.bg_expiry">Exp: {{site.bg_expiry}}</small>
              </td>

              <td class="vertical-middle text-right">
                <div><strong class="text-dark">₹ {{c.formatINR(site.order_rate)}}</strong> <small class="text-muted">/MT</small></div>

                <span ng-if="site.is_deviated" class="badge badge-danger abg-text-xs-10 m-t-xs display-block">DEVIATED</span>

              <td class="vertical-middle text-right text-success font-weight-bold font-size-13" style="background-color: #fafffb;">

                <span ng-if="c.isApproverMode && c.selectedRecord.state == 'Requested' && c.approvedAmount < c.selectedRecord.total_desired && site._inc == 0 && site.current_limit > 0" class="badge badge-default abg-text-xs-10 m-t-xs display-block">PROTECTED</span>
              </td>
            </tr>

            <!-- Expandable 6-Month Trailing Aging Row -->
            <tr ng-repeat-end ng-if="site.expanded" class="slide-down">
              <td colspan="9" class="abg-expanded-row">
                <h5 class="m-t-none m-b-sm text-primary font-weight-bold">
                  <i class="fa fa-bar-chart"></i> 6-Month Outstanding Aging ({{::site.code}} - {{::site.customer_name}})
                </h5>

                <div ng-if="site.isLoadingAging" class="text-center p-sm text-muted">
                  <i class="fa fa-spinner fa-spin fa-lg abg-text-red"></i> Loading historical aging buckets...
                </div>

                <div class="table-responsive m-b-none" ng-if="!site.isLoadingAging && site.buckets && site.buckets.length > 0">
                  <table class="table table-bordered table-condensed abg-expanded-table m-b-none">
                    <thead>
                      <tr>
                        <th>Month (Record)</th>

                    </thead>
                    <tbody>
                      <tr ng-repeat="b in site.buckets">
                        <td><strong>{{::b.month}}</strong></td>
                        <td class="text-right">₹{{::c.formatINR(b.b0_3)}}</td>
                        <td class="text-right">₹{{::c.formatINR(b.b4_7)}}</td>
                        <td class="text-right">₹{{::c.formatINR(b.b8_21)}}</td>
                        <td class="text-right">₹{{::c.formatINR(b.b22_30)}}</td>
                        <td class="text-right text-warning">₹{{::c.formatINR(b.b31_45)}}</td>

                        <td class="text-right font-weight-bold text-danger">₹{{::c.formatINR(b.total_os)}}</td>
                      </tr>
                    </tbody>
                  </table>
                </div>

                <div class="text-muted small p-sm text-center" ng-if="!site.isLoadingAging && (!site.buckets || site.buckets.length === 0)">
                  No historical outstanding data available for this customer code.
                </div>
              </td>
            </tr>
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    </div>
